concerns.text: SC‑001 requires a statistically significant MAE reduction (p < 0.05) versus the fingerprint baseline, but T010 only computes metrics and the generalization gap; it does not perform the paired significance test between GNN and baseline predictions.

SC‑002 mandates reporting Cohen’s d effect size and a minimum MAE increase of 0.05 eV for ablations, yet the ablation result schema (ablation_result.schema.yaml) lacks an effect‑size field and T008 does not enforce the MAE‑increase threshold.

SC‑009 (and SC‑012) require a primary a‑priori power analysis before the main training pipeline; T014 only implements this analysis as an optional fallback after a timeout, leaving the mandatory power check uncovered.

FR‑015 and SC‑010 call for correlation between GNN residuals and the fingerprint‑based baseline residuals, but T012 computes correlation with DFTB residuals instead, so the specified requirement is not satisfied.

FR‑011 specifies generating an AttributionMap for **each** ablation configuration, yet T009 produces attribution only for a single stratified subset of 1 000 test molecules without linking maps to individual ablation configs.
FR‑026 (Constitution Principle II) requires title‑overlap ≥ 0.7 for citation verification, but T001 only checks URL/metadata existence and does not compute the required overlap metric.

FR‑024 demands aborting the pipeline on construct‑validity failure; the unit‑test asserts the thresholds but does not explicitly enforce pipeline termination, risking downstream execution despite a failed validation.

FR‑004 includes a covariate‑balance clause (≤ 10 % imbalance); the verification checks for imbalance but does not assert that the final split meets the ≤ 10 % condition, potentially allowing an imbalanced split to pass.
FR‑015 (correlation between GNN residuals and baseline residuals) is not covered by any task; the only residual correlation computed is with DFTB (T012).
FR‑024 (pipeline abort on construct‑validity failure) is not explicitly enforced in any task; T001’s unit test only asserts thresholds without halting the pipeline.
FR‑026’s title‑overlap verification is missing; T001 does not implement the ≥ 0.7 overlap check required by the constitution.
SC‑002’s MAE‑increase threshold (≥ 0.05 eV) is not validated; T008’s verification only checks statistical significance and p‑value.
SC‑009 and SC‑012 require a primary power analysis before training; T007 does not perform this analysis, relying instead on the optional fallback in T014.
SC‑001’s paired significance test between GNN and baseline is missing; T010 only reports MAE/RMSE and the generalization gap.
SC‑010’s requirement for low correlation (|ρ| ≤ 0.2) between GNN residuals and the fingerprint baseline is unmet; T012 computes correlation with DFTB instead.
FR‑011’s requirement to generate an AttributionMap for each ablation configuration is not met; T009 generates maps only for a single subset, not per‑config.
FR‑026’s citation‑verification metric (title‑overlap ≥ 0.7) is absent; T001 only checks URL existence.
FR‑004’s covariate‑balance clause (≤ 10 % imbalance) is not enforced as a final assertion; the task only checks for imbalance but does not guarantee the final split satisfies the threshold.
